name: storymatrix
description: Story database template + read-only interactive dashboard / 故事数据库模板与只读仪表盘

scripts.templates: python tools/make_template.py --force && python tools/make_template.py --lang en --force && python tools/make_template.py --data templates/示例_星河旅店.data.json --out templates/示例_星河旅店.xlsx --force && python tools/make_template.py --lang en --data templates/example_starlight-inn.data.json --out templates/example_starlight-inn.xlsx --force
scripts.fields: node tools/storydb.mjs fields > templates/字段说明.md && node tools/storydb.mjs fields --lang en > templates/field-reference_en.md
